description: This file contains utility functions related to provider helpers in a trading platform, including request handling, HTTP session creation, certificate management, string manipulation, and date filtering.

methods.name: "Response" make_request( url: str, method: str = "GET", timeout: int = 10, **kwargs )
methods.description: Performs a synchronous HTTP request with added system headers and configurations.

methods.name: str to_snake_case(string: str)

methods.name: T maybe_coroutine( func: Callable[P, Union[T, Awaitable[T]]], /, *args: P.args, **kwargs: P.kwargs )

methods.name: T run_async( func: Callable[P, Awaitable[T]], /, *args: P.args, **kwargs: P.kwargs )

methods.name: list[D] filter_by_dates( data: list[D], start_date: Optional[date] = None, end_date: Optional[date] = None )
methods.description: Filters a list of Data objects based on start and end date.
